messages.subject: errors when running bootstrapping
parts:
Hi, all,

I am running indirect effects in multi-group SEM analysis. If I do not use the bootstrapping strategy, R code return the results. However, if I add "se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000", then I got this error:

"Error in parameterEstimates(object, ci = ci, standardized = standardized,  :
  !is.null(BOOT) is not TRUE"

What the problem is? I searched online and did not get any related answers. I used bootstrapping approach in other projects well. This is the first time reporting this error. 

I appreciate any help on this.

Thank you. Happy Holidays!
